name: MoveFile
description: Moves a file to another location within SharePoint using Microsoft Graph.
author: @rahmat

fields.name: __CredentialId__M365
fields.label: M365 Credential
fields.description: Select the Microsoft 365 credential used to authenticate the SharePoint request.

fields.name: FilePath
fields.label: Source File Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the file you want to move. For example: /sites/YourSite/Shared Documents/YourFile.txt

fields.name: DrivePath
fields.label: Destination Folder Path
fields.description: The full SharePoint URL of the destination folder where the file should be moved.

fields.name: Result
fields.label: Result
fields.description: The result of the file move operation, including success status and any error messages.
